about_the_game:
PINGORILE is a charming retro-style platformer where you play as a small, round penguin with a big dream — to fly.
Inspired by a bizarre TV show, Pingorile sets out to collect yellow budgies scattered across vibrant and varied levels. A mysterious ostrich on the show promised that collecting all of them could unlock the secret of flight.

Jump, dodge, and explore colorful pixel worlds full of surprises, secrets, and catchy music. Each level brings something new — from tricky jumps to chill vibes — all wrapped in nostalgic 2D fun.

Features:

  • Classic jump-and-run gameplay with smooth controls

  • A mix of cool and creative levels

  • Lots of budgies to collect — will they really help you fly?

  • Retro visuals and an original, diverse soundtrack

Are you ready to help him achieve the impossible?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or better
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio output
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Intel and Apple Silicon (Universal Build)
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics card
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio output
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Apple Silicon for best performance

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i3, AMD FX or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with WebGL support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 4000)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly even on older hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i3, AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly even on modern hardware.

short_description: A retro-style 2D platformer where you play as a penguin collecting yellow budgies to fulfill his dream of flying. Explore diverse levels, jump past obstacles, and enjoy a colorful, music-filled adventure.
